0:
Grey Guard

They make me so angry…
Serving the Shadow Lord.
And they're tough enough
to be a real pain.
1:
Wenn

I set off so boldly, but will
there be lots of these from now on?
Father, my heart feels heavy…
2:
Green Caterpillar

Honestly, I can't stand these.
The colour and smell are awful.
Touch one? No way. Keep away!
3:
Purple Caterpillar

Probably stronger than the green.
No, think that and you've lost.
I mean, it's a bug. A bug.
Still, I hate them.
4:
Wasp

Noisy buzzing bugs.
Bugs shouldn't be that strong,
but… If only they dropped honey.
5:
Spider

Spider. Bug. It may be a monster,
but think of it as a bug.
That calms the nerves.
Stay calm and nothing's scary!
6:
Shield Guard

Those hateful Grey Guards.
This one has a shield. Annoying, but
stay calm and get behind him.
I'm far quicker.
7:
Power Guard

I've fought Grey Guards many times.
But this one is huge. Never mind size.
I'm small, but I can turn fast.
8:
Elite Guard

Why that sneering look?
How horrible… I bet he thinks
I'm an idiot.
We'll see about that!
9:
Crocodile

Crocodiles… I'd only seen them in
books. Kind of cool animals.
No, there's no time for that!
10:
Water Snake

Water scares me. You never know
what's in there. To think these
are down there… Brrr.
11:
Bloodsucker

They latch on and drink your blood.
And they come in swarms.
Ugh… My neck's all itchy.
12:
Frogfish

Why is a fish attacking me?
Is the world itself on the Shadow
Lord's side? No, surely not.
13:
Rat

Just an ordinary rat, surely.
There are rats in Del too, and
Mother always makes a fuss.
But these are no ordinary rats.
Good thing Mother isn't here.
14:
False Wolf

Looks like a wolf, but it's a
monster. As if wolves weren't
scary enough.
15:
Giant Scorpion

A real enemy-looking enemy.
It means no harm, I suppose, but if
it attacks, I must beat it.
Is it a bug? Bugs are less scary.
16:
Sand Caterpillar

Those horrible grubs again.
Some insect's larva, I suppose.
The adults must be worse, so I'll
beat them now! Ugh, but I hate them.
17:
Tarantula

The colour of bugs changes with
where they live. I learned that on
this journey. And that enemies grow
stronger the further from Del I go.
18:
Antlion

Don't take them lightly and you won't
regret it, Father said. Fighting these,
I see what he meant. If I lost to
this, I couldn't face him.
19:
Red Wing Bug

A bug with red wings. That's all.
That's all… So why do I feel my
life's in danger?
20:
Bluetongue Lizard

That blue tongue goes in and out.
What's it doing? Is it studying us?
Don't copy it while fighting,
you'll bite your tongue!
21:
Python

Ha ha ha ha…
Ha ha ha ha ha…
This is why I hate the water.
Something slimy strokes your leg.
22:
Hornet

They might drop honey! I can't
help but fight them.
Bzzzzzz… Please don't sting me!
23:
Bandit

Everyone's struggling to live…
And they steal from those people…
Bandits! I won't forgive you!
24:
Dread Gnome

A warlike tribe… I suppose.
If only we could all be friends.
25:
Death Scorpion

I don't want to be stung…
If it stings, it'll hurt…
I don't want to be stung!
26:
Fly

Enemies like this make me wonder.
Monster? Or just a bug?
"I lost to a bug" would be so
embarrassing.
27:
Lizard

Lizards are cool.
At any other time, I'd have
thought so.
28:
Rockdile

How many kinds of crocodile
are there in this world?
No, this is no time to wonder!
29:
Worm

I hate this kind of enemy.
Squishy things. Squidgy things.
Stay away!
30:
Tree Rat

The rats around here seem much
stronger than elsewhere.
I mustn't get used to rats.
31:
Poison Bloodsucker

You're not getting one drop of
my blood!
33:
River Fish

River creatures are my enemies
too…? We're trying to save
the world, you know!
34:
Pirate

They team up with the Captain to
attack travellers. It's not only
the Shadow Lord making people
suffer. I won't stand for it!
35:
Ol

Horrible… To change into people
and animals. They may be the
strongest of the Shadow Lord's
servants.
36:
Mary and Ida

What on earth were they doing
in a place like this…
37:
Woman in the Pink Dress

She seems out of place…
38:
Goat

I think it's a goat.
Or is it an Ol? It looks like an Ol.
It must be an Ol.
I can't trust anything any more.
39:
Swamp Viper

That colour screams poison!
…I want to run.
40:
Porcupine Wolf

A worthy opponent.
I'd like to think I've grown
enough to say that.
41:
Green Worm

Nothing could be a more horrible
shade of green. No, no!
Stop complaining and fight!
42:
Valley Tarantula

Almost nostalgic by now.
Come on, all at once!
No, actually, please don't!
43:
Ghost Mushroom

I never thought I'd fight a
mushroom. Mushrooms are tasty, but
this one's bound to taste awful.
Not that I'd eat it.
44:
Snapweed

If this gets me, I'm in
serious trouble…
45:
Dark Moth

They may be those grubs all
grown up. I hope they're not
out for revenge!
46:
Wennbar

Did it get this big from eating
Grey Guards? I don't even want
to think about being eaten.
47:
Gorl

There seems to be a story here.
But it's nothing to do with us.
Or maybe it is, but our journey's
only begun. I can't worry about it!
48:
Soldeen

So this is Soldeen, feared by
the Ralads. Beat him and the gem
is ours. Yes… a Guardian of the Gems.
49:
Reeah the Great Snake

A Guardian of the Gems. Did eating
rats make it this big? It tried to
control me, and foretold the future…
I won't be fooled!
50:
The Sand Beast

There's nothing to eat in a world
of sand. Oh… So it's hungry…
And it's going to eat me…
That makes me shiver…
51:
Vraal

Huge… Strong-looking…
But not very bright.
52:
Gellick

A big toad. Think of it that way
and it's not scary. No, scared or
not, I must beat it!
As long as it holds the gem!
53:
The Glus

Not quite like the other Guardians.
Is there some way to avoid
fighting… No, it's impossible.
54:
Thaegan

I think she's very beautiful.
But her eyes are cold. What would
make Thaegan happy… All I know is,
we can't be happy until she's beaten.
55:
Guardian and Monsters

Beat them and the last gem is ours.
The Belt will be complete!
Just one more push!
56:
Ichabod

He seems proud of his purple tongue.
What did he want, following us?
Shadow Lord's orders?
Or was it the witch Thaegan?
57:
Fallow

How dare you… my parents!
Not just my parents! You're the
enemy of the whole world!
58:
Manus

A Ralad, enslaved by the Guards.
Barda was against it, but I couldn't
leave him. I'm so glad we saved him.
59:
Ralads

They're so kind to us for saving
Manus. It makes us happy. But please
don't be so nice. It'll make
leaving too hard.
60:
Jin & Jod

They tricked us and tried to eat
us. Me or Jasmine, fine, but who
would want to eat Barda?
They must be really desperate.
61:
Ra-Kacharz

They force harsh laws on the people
of Noradz. I bet no one's ever stood
up to them before.
How does that feel?
62:
Tira

A girl from Noradz. We keep saving
each other. She thinks life there is
normal. I'd love to show her
the outside world.
63:
People of Noradz

They live by totally different
rules. It looks stifling to me,
though perhaps that's none of
my business.
64:
Queen Bee

If only Barda hadn't stolen those
apples, she wouldn't have scolded
us so much…
65:
Mother Brightly

She runs the Champion Inn and was
very kind. But her kindness makes
me suspicious. I know I shouldn't
think that way.
66:
Doom

I've met many people, but none this
suspicious. Yet there seems to be
more to him than that…
67:
Ferdinand

A swindler at a glance.
Cheat! Cheat! But compared to what
the Shadow Lord does, his cheating
is nothing.
68:
Prin

A Kin child who hates being treated
like a child. Getting mad is proof
you're a child. Wait, does that
mean me too!?
69:
Kin

I remember having a stuffed one
when I was little. I thought they
were legends. Meeting one is amazing.
I'd love to see them again after
the Shadow Lord is beaten…
70:
Gla-Thon

She's a woman… right?
Brisk and sharp. It would feel
good to have her on our side.
71:
Fa-Glin

Elder of the Gnomes. They must have
their troubles. Is the Shadow Lord
to blame? Then we can surely be
friends!
72:
Dain

The royal heir!? Can I believe him?
I can't, really. But I think I'll
know him longer than the others.
I hope he's a good guy!
73:
Steven

A Resistance helper who knows Dain.
He's the son of the orchard lady
whose apples Barda stole.
Yes, I think I can trust him.
74:
Captain and Polypan

Honestly, I just can't trust them.
Better not to get too involved.
Polypan has sticky fingers.
Be careful, be careful!
75:
Child in the Purple Cloak

She seems very refined…
About my age, I think…
76:
Glock

Not that tall, but his bulging
muscles make him like a rock.
I'll secretly call him Rock Man.
77:
Zeean

A Toran. Deeply regrets ignoring
King Endon's plea. If they'd kept
their oath… No, there's no point
saying that now.
78:
Torans

They look so sad…
What could they be seeking…
79:
Jarred

Father… I wanted to be a blacksmith,
but you made me study history and
travel lore. Was it all for this day?
80:
Anna

Mother.
I love you so much, Mother.
I can't find any more words.
81:
Tom

Friend or foe? His goods can be
trusted, though… Don't sell to
the Grey Guards!
82:
Lief and Friends

In a land ruled by the Shadow Lord,
he stayed on the straight path and
grew up honest and strong. Clever
too, and brave… Or so I'd like to think.
83:
Blister Man

Wow. A Blister with legs.
This world is full of mysteries.
84:
Gingerbread Cookie

This thing's a cookie… right?
Here I am, fighting a cookie.
Father, will you believe me?
Mother, it's true.
85:
Turtle Cannon

It shuts itself up and attacks. And
that defence is solid. Well, it's a
turtle. Big and strong. At least
it doesn't move around.
86:
Heavy Cannon

This one's really big. How long has
it been alive? Has it always lived
like this? Not that I should be
wondering about its life story.
87:
Flame Horse

I thought horses were friends.
Or at least not enemies.
But this one…
88:
Nightmare

Black monsters make me think of
darkness and shadows. That is, of
the Shadow Lord. Not fun at all.
And black is such a cool colour.
89:
Mounted Guard

Beat the horse and he's just a Grey
Guard. Both are tough, but separately
I can manage. That thought helps.
90:
Combined Guard

They're Grey Guards, but… very odd.
Do they practise fighting like that?
91:
Roper

Barda says he hates these monsters.
You can't tell from outside what
they'll do. Of course, I hate them too.
92:
Sand Roper

They move underground. Who knows
what they do down there. It keeps
me on edge, and that's tiring.
93:
Dread Roper

These ones are tough. You think
"oh, these again", but the colour's
different. Then you must be careful.
Basic knowledge for dangerous travel.
94:
Face Rock

Tell me this one's secretly kind
and I won't believe it. But relax.
It's just as nasty as it looks.
95:
Yellow Dragon

Just like the dragons in books.
Fighting one makes me feel like an
adventure hero, and that's a bit
exciting. Exciting, but painful.
96:
Red Dragon

A red dragon… As dangerous as it
looks. Touch it and you'd get
burned. Who'd touch it!
97:
Dark Dragon

Black means shadow. And it's strong.
Oh, I'm starting to hate black.
98:
Green Dragon

Is that colour to hide in woods?
To hide, watch, then suddenly attack?
Dragons should fight fair.
99:
Blue Dragon

A blue one. But nothing like fresh
blue skies or cool rivers and lakes.
It's a plan to catch me off guard!
100:
Mimic

I can't help opening treasure chests.
And this thing… It's a dirty trick.
A really dirty trick.
The shock is huge too.
101:
Jelly

Weak. So weak, fighting it is a
bother. But maybe that's its plan.
Not that it looks like it plans.
102:
Grand Serpent

"Now that's a monster worth
fighting," Jasmine would say.
I actually think so too.
103:
Jack

A peaceful sort of old man.
I fight to protect his peace.
Jasmine may be in it for the reward.
104:
Mokeet

I don't think we could be friends.
A spoiled sort of fellow. When the
world's at peace, he should
work until he drops.
105:
Mikeeta

I don't really understand her odd
bond with Mokeet. In fact, I've
no idea what she's thinking.
106:
Young Jarred

I keep forgetting Father was young
once. The father in my memory
always has a beard. No beard, and
young… It doesn't feel right.
107:
Young Endon

The former king of Deltora. I grew
up hearing what a fool he was.
I wonder what he was really like…
108:
Young Anna

My mother. She seems a little
different from now. I suppose
that's what growing old does.
109:
Young Sharn

King Endon's queen. A total stranger…
Or so I thought. Something's familiar.
110:
Crian

Mother's grandfather, my
great-grandfather. He took great care
of Father when he was young.
I wish I could have met him…
111:
Prandine

Chief Adviser in King Endon's time.
That's the top adviser of all.
The king did all he said, they say.
Hm. Doesn't that make him a bad man?
